questions.question: The price of fuel decreases by 35%, 55% and 35% in three successive months, but increases by 65% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price? (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let original price = 100

After 35% decrease ⇒ 100 × 0.65 = 65

After 55% decrease ⇒ 65 × 0.45 = 29.25

After 35% decrease ⇒ 29.25 × 0.65 = 19.0125

After 65% increase ⇒ 19.0125 × 1.65 = 31.37

Net change = 31.37 − 100 = −68.63%

**∴ Answer = 68.63% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive changes: −35%, −55%, −35%, +65%

**Formula used:**

Net factor = (1 − 0.35)(1 − 0.55)(1 − 0.35)(1 + 0.65)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Net factor = 0.65 × 0.45 × 0.65 × 1.65

⇒ = 0.3137

⇒ Final price = 0.3137 × original

⇒ % change = (0.3137 − 1) × 100

⇒ = −0.6863 × 100 = −68.63%

**∴ The correct answer is 68.63% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Change

Multiply all change factors

Decrease/Increase

Decrease ⇒ (1 − x), Increase ⇒ (1 + x)

Net Effect

Compare final with original

Key Insight

Never add percentages directly

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 74 and their difference is 12. Find the ratio of the smaller number to the larger number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of smaller to larger number = (Sum − Difference) : (Sum + Difference)

⇒ Ratio = (74 − 12) : (74 + 12)

⇒ Ratio = 62 : 86 = 31 : 43

**∴ The correct answer is 31 : 43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of two numbers = 74

Difference of the numbers = 12

 
 Larger Number (43)
 
 
 Smaller (31)
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Diff = 12
 
 Sum = 74
 Ratio = Smaller : Larger = 31 : 43

**Calculations:**

Let the larger number be x and the smaller number be y.

⇒ x + y = 74

⇒ x − y = 12

Adding both equations:

⇒ 2x = 86

⇒ x = 43

Substituting x = 43 in the first equation:

⇒ 43 + y = 74

⇒ y = 74 − 43 = 31

Ratio of smaller number to larger number:

⇒ Ratio = y : x

⇒ Ratio = 31 : 43

**∴ The correct answer is 31 : 43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum and Difference Rule

If the sum (S) and difference (D) of two numbers are given, the larger number is found directly by (S + D) ÷ 2 and the smaller number by (S − D) ÷ 2.

Ratio Properties

A ratio a:b can be simplified to its lowest terms by dividing both parts by their Highest Common Factor (HCF). In this case, 62 and 86 were both divided by 2 to reach 31 : 43.

Componendo and Dividendo

If a/b = c/d, then (a+b)/(a−b) = (c+d)/(c−d). This rule is highly useful in ratio and proportion questions involving symmetrical sums and differences.
</p

questions.question: In a cyclic quadrilateral ABCD, the sides are AB = 10 cm, BC = 14 cm, CD = 8 cm, and DA = 12 cm. Find the area of the quadrilateral.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a cyclic quadrilateral, direct area using Brahmagupta's formula = √((s − a)(s − b)(s − c)(s − d))

Semi-perimeter (s) = (10 + 14 + 8 + 12) ÷ 2 = 22 cm

Area = √((22 − 10) × (22 − 14) × (22 − 8) × (22 − 12))

Area = √(12 × 8 × 14 × 10) = √(13440)

Area = √(64 × 210) = 8√210 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 8√210 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The sides of the cyclic quadrilateral ABCD are:

a (AB) = 10 cm, b (BC) = 14 cm, c (CD) = 8 cm, and d (DA) = 12 cm.

 
 

 A
 B
 C
 D

 14 cm
 8 cm
 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Brahmagupta's Formula is used to calculate the area of a cyclic quadrilateral:

Area = √((s − a)(s − b)(s − c)(s − d))

where 's' is the semi-perimeter: s = (a + b + c + d) ÷ 2

**Calculation:**

⇒ s = (10 + 14 + 8 + 12) ÷ 2

⇒ s = 44 ÷ 2 = 22 cm

⇒ Area = √((22 − 10) × (22 − 14) × (22 − 8) × (22 − 12))

⇒ Area = √(12 × 8 × 14 × 10)

⇒ Area = √(13440)

⇒ Area = √(64 × 210)

⇒ Area = 8√210 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 8√210 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Brahmagupta's Formula

This specific formula works directly to find the area of any cyclic quadrilateral when all four side lengths are known. If the quadrilateral is strictly non-cyclic, this direct formula cannot be applied.

Cyclic Quadrilateral Properties

A quadrilateral is called cyclic if all four of its vertices lie perfectly on a single circumscribed circle. The most important characteristic is that the sum of its opposite angles is always exactly 180° (supplementary).

Ptolemy's Theorem

In any cyclic quadrilateral, the product of the two diagonals is identical to the sum of the products of the opposite sides: d₁ × d₂ = (a × c) + (b × d).
</p

questions.question: P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 15 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern with water in 60 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill one-fourth of the same cistern with water?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity of the cistern = LCM(15, 60) = 60 units.

Efficiency of (P + Q) = 60 ÷ 15 = 4 units/hour.

Efficiency of P = 60 ÷ 60 = 1 unit/hour.

Efficiency of Q = 4 − 1 = 3 units/hour.

Time for Q to fill 1/4th of the cistern = (60 × 1/4) ÷ 3 = 15 ÷ 3 = 5 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by P and Q together to fill the cistern = 15 hours

Time taken by P alone to fill the cistern = 60 hours

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time Taken

Time Taken = Total Work ÷ Efficiency

 
 

 **Person**
 **Hours**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 P + Q
 15
 60
 4
 
 

 P
 60
 1
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total work is assumed as the LCM of 15 and 60, which is 60 units.

⇒ Efficiency of Q = Efficiency of (P + Q) − Efficiency of P

⇒ Efficiency of Q = 4 − 1 = 3 units/hour.

⇒ Total work to be done = 1/4th of the cistern capacity = 60 × 1/4 = 15 units.

⇒ Time taken by Q to fill 1/4th of the cistern = Work to be done ÷ Efficiency of Q

⇒ Time taken = 15 ÷ 3 = 5 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns Concept

If pipe A can fill a tank in x hours and pipe B can empty it in y hours, then the net part filled in 1 hour is (1/x − 1/y). Emptying pipes have a negative efficiency.

Combined Work Formula

If two pipes A and B can fill a tank in x hours and y hours respectively, working together they can fill the tank in (x × y) ÷ (x + y) hours.

Work Proportionality

The amount of work done is directly proportional to the efficiency and the time spent. Total Work = Efficiency × Time.

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹7,500 at 6% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective compound interest rate for 2 years at 6% = 6 + 6 + (6 × 6)/100 = 12.36%

Total amount percentage = 100% + 12.36% = 112.36%

Amount = 112.36% of 7500

Amount = 1.1236 × 7500 = 8427

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,427.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹7,500

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per annum

Time (n) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

 
 
 

 
 

 Compound Interest Timeline

 
 ₹7500
 Principal

 
• 
 + 6% CI

 
 ₹7950
 End of Year 1

 
• 
 + 6% CI

 
 ₹8427
 End of Year 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Amount = 7500 × (1 + 6/100)²

⇒ Amount = 7500 × (106/100)²

⇒ Amount = 7500 × (53/50) × (53/50)

⇒ Amount = 7500 × (2809/2500)

⇒ Amount = 3 × 2809

⇒ Amount = 8427

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,427.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Compound Interest

For 2 years at R%, the effective compound rate is calculated as 2R + (R²/100)%. This allows you to find the total interest directly as a percentage.

Half-Yearly Compounding

If compounded half-yearly, the Rate becomes R/2 and Time becomes 2n periods. The formula adjusts to A = P(1 + R/200)²ⁿ.

Difference Between CI and SI

For exactly 2 years, the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on a principal P is calculated as Difference = P × (R/100)².

questions.question: A fruit seller has 24 kg apples worth ₹3,600. He sells 12 kg apples at a gain of 20% and the remaining at a loss of 10%. Find his gain or loss (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total CP = 3600 for 24 kg ⇒ CP per kg = 150

First 12 kg at 20% gain ⇒ SP/kg = 150 × 1.2 = 180

SP₁ = 12 × 180 = 2160

Next 12 kg at 10% loss ⇒ SP/kg = 150 × 0.9 = 135

SP₂ = 12 × 135 = 1620

Total SP = 2160 + 1620 = 3780

Profit = 3780 − 3600 = 180

**∴ Answer = ₹180 profit**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total apples = 24 kg, Total cost = ₹3600

Sold 12 kg at 20% gain, remaining at 10% loss

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (1 ± % change)

**Calculation:**

⇒ CP per kg = 3600 ÷ 24 = 150

⇒ First 12 kg:

SP = 150 × 1.2 = 180 per kg

Total = 12 × 180 = 2160

⇒ Next 12 kg:

SP = 150 × 0.9 = 135 per kg

Total = 12 × 135 = 1620

⇒ Total SP = 2160 + 1620 = 3780

⇒ Profit = 3780 − 3600 = 180

**∴ The correct answer is ₹180 profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unitary Method

Find cost per kg first

Profit/Loss

Apply % separately on each part

Total Comparison

Compare total SP with total CP

Key Insight

Split quantities before applying %

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, Dinesh received 46.5% of the total votes and lost to Rizwan by a margin of 3150 votes. If all votes cast were valid, how many votes did Rizwan secure?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Dinesh = 46.5% ⇒ Rizwan = 53.5%

Margin = 53.5% − 46.5% = 7%

7% of total votes = 3150

Total votes = 3150 ÷ 0.07 = 45000

Rizwan’s votes = 53.5% of 45000 = 24075

**∴ Answer = 24075**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Dinesh = 46.5%, Margin = 3150 votes

**Formula used:**

Margin = Difference in % × Total votes

**Calculation:**

⇒ Rizwan = 100 − 46.5 = 53.5%

⇒ Difference = 53.5 − 46.5 = 7%

⇒ 7% of total votes = 3150

⇒ Total votes = 3150 ÷ 0.07 = 45000

⇒ Rizwan’s votes = 53.5% of 45000

⇒ = 0.535 × 45000 = 24075

**∴ The correct answer is 24075.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Voting Concept

Total = sum of both candidates

Margin Formula

Margin = % difference × total votes

Percentage Split

Winner + loser = 100%

Key Insight

Use difference percentage to find total first

questions.question: If the third proportional to 50 and Z is 18, then what is the value of Z?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For three numbers A, B, and C in continued proportion, the relation is B² = A × C.

Given the first term A = 50, the mean term B = Z, and the third term C = 18.

Z² = 50 × 18 = 900

Z = √900 = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 50

 (B)

 Third Term
 (C)
 
 
 Formula: B² = A × C

**Given:**

First proportional (A) = 50

Mean proportional (B) = Z

Third proportional (C) = 18

**Formula Used:**

If three numbers are in continued proportion, their ratio satisfies A : B = B : C.

This fractional relation can be written as A / B = B / C

Cross-multiplying gives B² = A × C

**Calculation:**

⇒ Z² = 50 × 18

⇒ Z² = 900

⇒ Z = √900

⇒ Z = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers A and B is derived from the proportion formula and is equal to √(A × B).

Fourth Proportional

If D is the fourth proportional to three given numbers A, B, and C, then A : B = C : D, which simplifies to A × D = B × C.

Continued Proportion

Three numbers A, B, and C are said to be in continued proportion if the ratio of the first to the second is directly equal to the ratio of the second to the third (A : B = B : C).

questions.question: In a race, an athlete covers a distance of 300 m in 100 sec in the first lap. He covers the second lap of the same length in 50 sec. What is the average speed (in m/sec) of the athlete?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 300 + 300 = 600 m

Total time = 100 + 50 = 150 sec

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

= 600 ÷ 150 = 4 m/sec

**∴ Answer = 4 m/sec**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance of each lap = 300 m

Time taken = 100 sec and 50 sec

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 300 + 300 = 600 m

⇒ Total time = 100 + 50 = 150 sec

⇒ Average speed = 600 ÷ 150 = 4 m/sec

**∴ The correct answer is 4 m/sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Total distance ÷ total time

Important Note

Do not average speeds directly

Key Insight

Use combined distance and time

questions.question: The sum of the present ages of two sisters is 67 years. Five years ago from now, the elder sister was twice as old as the younger one. Find the elder sister's current age.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let elder = E, younger = Y

E + Y = 67

5 years ago ⇒ E − 5 = 2(Y − 5)

⇒ E = 2Y − 5

Substitute ⇒ (2Y − 5) + Y = 67

⇒ 3Y = 72 ⇒ Y = 24

⇒ E = 67 − 24 = 43

**∴ Answer = 43 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of ages = 67

5 years ago condition

**Formula used:**

Age relation with time shift

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let younger sister’s age = x

⇒ Elder sister’s age = 67 − x

⇒ 5 years ago:

(67 − x − 5) = 2(x − 5)

⇒ 62 − x = 2x − 10

⇒ 72 = 3x ⇒ x = 24

⇒ Elder sister’s age = 67 − 24 = 43

**∴ The correct answer is 43 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Concept

Translate statements into equations

Time Shift

Subtract years for past ages

Equation Solving

Solve linear equations step-by-step

Key Insight

Use substitution to eliminate variables

questions.question: For 6 innings, a cricketer had an average of 90 runs. In the 7th inning, he scored 157 runs. His average score increased by _______. (Round off the answer to the nearest whole number.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total runs in 6 innings = 6 × 90 = 540

After 7th inning ⇒ total = 540 + 157 = 697

New average = 697 ÷ 7 ≈ 99.57

Increase = 99.57 − 90 ≈ 9.57 ≈ 10

**∴ Answer = 10**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 6 innings = 90

7th inning score = 157

**Formula used:**

Total runs = Average × number of innings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs in 6 innings = 6 × 90 = 540

⇒ Total runs in 7 innings = 540 + 157 = 697

⇒ New average = 697 ÷ 7 = 99.57

⇒ Increase in average = 99.57 − 90 = 9.57 ≈ 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Concept

Average = Total ÷ Number

New Average

Add new value and divide by updated count

Rounding

Round to nearest whole number

Key Insight

Work with totals first, then find average

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 88 and their L.C.M. is 870. The two numbers are:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve instantly using the option elimination method.

The sum of the numbers in all options is exactly 88.

Check the L.C.M. for Option 1: 30 = 2 × 3 × 5 and 58 = 2 × 29.

L.C.M. of 30 and 58 = 2 × 3 × 5 × 29 = 870.

Since Option 1 perfectly satisfies both conditions, it is the required answer.

**∴ The correct answer is 30, 58.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of two numbers = 88

L.C.M. of the two numbers = 870

**Method Used:**

Let the H.C.F of the numbers be h.

Let the numbers be hx and hy, where x and y are coprime numbers.

Sum = h(x + y) and L.C.M = hxy

**Calculations:**

⇒ h(x + y) = 88

⇒ hxy = 870

⇒ The H.C.F. h must be a common factor of both 88 and 870.

⇒ Prime factorization of 88 = 2³ × 11

⇒ Prime factorization of 870 = 2 × 3 × 5 × 29

⇒ The highest common factor h = 2.

⇒ Substituting h = 2 in our equations, we get x + y = 88 ÷ 2 = 44

⇒ And, xy = 870 ÷ 2 = 435

⇒ We need two coprime numbers whose sum is 44 and product is 435.

⇒ Resolving 435 into factors: 435 = 15 × 29.

⇒ We can see that 15 and 29 are coprime and 15 + 29 = 44.

⇒ So, x = 15 and y = 29.

⇒ The two numbers are 2 × 15 = 30 and 2 × 29 = 58.

**∴ The correct answer is 30, 58.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product of Two Numbers

For any two given numbers a and b, the product of the numbers is exactly equal to the product of their H.C.F. and L.C.M. Formula: a × b = H.C.F. × L.C.M.

Co-prime Number Rule

When a number is represented as a product of its H.C.F. and another factor, the remaining factors of the two numbers must be co-prime (having an H.C.F. of 1) to avoid changing the original H.C.F.

H.C.F. & L.C.M. of Fractions

L.C.M. of fractions = L.C.M. of numerators ÷ H.C.F. of denominators. H.C.F. of fractions = H.C.F. of numerators ÷ L.C.M. of denominators.

questions.question: If 8 solid spherical balls, each of radius 10 cm, are melted and recast into a single spherical ball, then what is the radius of the new ball so formed?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume conserved ⇒ n × r³ = R³

8 × 10³ = R³

R³ = 8000 ⇒ R = 20

**∴ Answer = 20 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of spheres = 8

Radius of each sphere = 10 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total volume of 8 small spheres = 8 × (4/3)π(10³)

⇒ Volume of new sphere = (4/3)πR³

⇒ Equate volumes

⇒ 8 × (4/3)π(10³) = (4/3)πR³

⇒ 8 × 1000 = R³

⇒ R³ = 8000

⇒ R = ∛8000

⇒ R = 20 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 20 cm.**

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 78, 66, 89, 55, 73, 45, 23, 46 and 29 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed mean be 50.

Net deviation from 50 = +28 + 16 + 39 + 5 + 23 − 5 − 27 − 4 − 21 = +54

Average deviation = +54 ÷ 9 = +6

Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + Average Deviation = 50 + 6 = 56

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations = 78, 66, 89, 55, 73, 45, 23, 46, 29

Number of observations (n) = 9

**Formula Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations

 Data Observations
 78, 66, 89, 55, 73, 45, 23, 46, 29
 
 
 Total Sum = 504 (9 items)
 
 
• 
 
 
 Mean = 504 ÷ 9
 
 Result = 56

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum = 78 + 66 + 89 + 55 + 73 + 45 + 23 + 46 + 29

⇒ Sum = 504

⇒ Mean = 504 ÷ 9

⇒ Mean = 56

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean of Consecutive Numbers

For a series of consecutive numbers or any arithmetic progression, the arithmetic mean is always equal to the exact middle term or (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2.

Weighted Average

When data values x₁, x₂ have individual weights w₁, w₂, the weighted average is calculated as (w₁×x₁ + w₂×x₂) ÷ (w₁ + w₂).

Combined Mean

If two distinct groups have sizes n₁ and n₂ with respective means A₁ and A₂, the total combined mean of both groups is (n₁×A₁ + n₂×A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

questions.question: Find a single discount (approximately) equal to three consecutive discounts of 2%, 8% and 15%.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the multiplying factor method for successive discounts:

Net selling price = MP × (1 − 2/100) × (1 − 8/100) × (1 − 15/100)

Net selling price = MP × 0.98 × 0.92 × 0.85 = MP × 0.76636

Net equivalent discount = (1 − 0.76636) × 100% = 23.364% ≈ 23.36%

**∴ The correct answer is 23.36%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three consecutive discounts = 2%, 8% and 15%

**Formula Used:**

Equivalent discount for two successive discounts a% and b% = [a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100]%

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, combine the 2% and 8% discounts.

⇒ Equivalent discount (d₁,₂) = 2 + 8 − (2 × 8) ÷ 100

⇒ Equivalent discount (d₁,₂) = 10 − 0.16 = 9.84%

⇒ Now, combine this equivalent discount of 9.84% with the third discount of 15%.

⇒ Total equivalent discount = 9.84 + 15 − (9.84 × 15) ÷ 100

⇒ Total equivalent discount = 24.84 − 147.6 ÷ 100

⇒ Total equivalent discount = 24.84 − 1.476 = 23.364%

⇒ Rounding off to two decimal places, we get 23.36%.

**∴ The correct answer is 23.36%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts Concept

When discounts are offered one after another on the marked price, they are called successive discounts. The final selling price is calculated sequentially on the reduced prices, not on the original base price.

Formula for Multiple Discounts

For three successive discounts of a%, b%, and c%, Final SP = MP × (100 − a) ÷ 100 × (100 − b) ÷ 100 × (100 − c) ÷ 100.

Net Discount vs Sum of Discounts

The equivalent single discount of successive discounts is always less than the sum of the individual discounts (e.g., 2% + 8% + 15% = 25%, but the effective net discount is only 23.36%).

questions.question: A total profit of ₹21,800 is to be distributed amongst A, B and C such that A : B = 4 : 15 and B : C = 9 : 3. The share (in ₹) of B in the profit is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Make B common from both ratios: A : B = 4 : 15 and B : C = 9 : 3

LCM of 15 and 9 = 45 ⇒ scale ratios

A : B = 12 : 45 and B : C = 45 : 15

So A : B : C = 12 : 45 : 15 ⇒ total parts = 72

**∴ B's share = (45/72) × 21800 = 13625**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total profit = 21800, A : B = 4 : 15 and B : C = 9 : 3

**Formula used:**

Convert into combined ratio and use share = (individual ratio / total ratio) × total amount

**Calculation:**

⇒ A : B = 4 : 15

⇒ B : C = 9 : 3 = 3 : 1

⇒ Make B equal: LCM of 15 and 3 = 15

⇒ A : B = 4 : 15

⇒ B : C = 15 : 5

⇒ So A : B : C = 4 : 15 : 5

⇒ Total parts = 4 + 15 + 5 = 24

⇒ B’s share = (15/24) × 21800

⇒ = 13625

**∴ The correct answer is 13625.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combining Ratios

To combine A : B and B : C, make B equal using LCM, then merge into A : B : C.

Share Formula

Individual share = (individual ratio / total ratio) × total amount

Alligation Concept

Useful in ratios to balance quantities by cross multiplication.

Ratio Scaling

Multiplying ratios by a constant does not change their proportion.

questions.question: The price of milk has increased by 20%. By how much should the consumption be reduced to maintain the monthly expenditure constant on milk?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expenditure constant ⇒ Price × Quantity = constant

If price increases by 20%, quantity must decrease inversely

Required reduction % = (increase % / (100 + increase %)) × 100

= (20 / 120) × 100 = 16(2)/(3)\% 

**∴ Answer = 16(2)/(3)\% **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Price increases by 20% and expenditure remains constant

**Formula used:**

Expenditure = Price × Quantity

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let initial price = 100 and quantity = 100

⇒ Initial expenditure = 100 × 100 = 10000

⇒ New price = 120

⇒ New quantity = 10000 ÷ 120 = 83.33

⇒ Reduction in quantity = 100 − 83.33 = 16.67

⇒ % reduction = (16.67 / 100) × 100 = 16(2)/(3)\% 

**∴ The correct answer is 16(2)/(3)\% **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion

When expenditure is constant, price and quantity vary inversely: Price × Quantity = constant

Percentage Reduction Formula

Reduction % = (Increase % / (100 + Increase %)) × 100

Successive Percentage Concept

Increase in one factor requires proportional decrease in another to maintain balance.

Quick Trick

For price increase x%, reduction in consumption = x / (100 + x) × 100

questions.question: Which of the options has the two prime numbers whose product is the biggest even number less than 30?805
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Biggest even number less than 30 = 28

Check prime factor pairs of 28

28 = 2 × 14 (14 not prime) ⇒ reject

Next even: 26 = 2 × 13 (both prime)

**∴ Answer = 2 and 13**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Find two prime numbers whose product is the greatest even number less than 30

**Formula used:**

Even number = 2 × any integer, and primes have only two factors

**Calculation:**

⇒ Even numbers less than 30: 28, 26, 24, ...

⇒ Check 28 = 2 × 14 (14 not prime)

⇒ Check 26 = 2 × 13 (both prime)

⇒ 26 is valid and is the largest such even number

**∴ The correct answer is 2 and 13.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Numbers

A prime number has exactly two factors: 1 and itself (e.g., 2, 3, 5, 7, 11...).

Even Numbers

All even numbers are multiples of 2.

Prime Factorization

Breaking a number into product of primes helps verify validity.

Quick Strategy

Start from largest target number and check downward for valid prime products.

questions.question: The sides of a triangle are 35 cm, 44 cm and 75 cm. What is the length of its altitude corresponding to the side with the length of 44 cm?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Semi-perimeter (s) = (35 + 44 + 75) ÷ 2 = 77 cm.

Area = √[77 × (77 − 35) × (77 − 44) × (77 − 75)] = √(77 × 42 × 33 × 2) = 462 cm².

Altitude to 44 cm side = (2 × Area) ÷ Base = (2 × 462) ÷ 44 = 21 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
• 
• 
 
 44 cm 35 cm 75 cm h = ? A B C D 

**Given:**

Sides of the triangle, a = 35 cm, b = 44 cm, and c = 75 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Area of triangle = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)]

Semi-perimeter, s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

Area of triangle = (1/2) × base × height

**Calculation:**

⇒ s = (35 + 44 + 75) ÷ 2 = 154 ÷ 2 = 77 cm

⇒ Area = √[77 × (77 − 35) × (77 − 44) × (77 − 75)]

⇒ Area = √[77 × 42 × 33 × 2]

⇒ Area = √[7 × 11 × 7 × 6 × 11 × 3 × 2]

⇒ Area = √[(7 × 7) × (11 × 11) × (6 × 6)]

⇒ Area = 7 × 11 × 6 = 462 cm²

Let the altitude corresponding to the side 44 cm be h.

⇒ 462 = (1/2) × 44 × h

⇒ 462 = 22 × h

⇒ h = 462 ÷ 22 = 21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

Heron's formula is used to calculate the area of a triangle when all three side lengths are known. Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)].

Obtuse-Angled Triangle Property

If the square of the longest side is greater than the sum of the squares of the other two sides (c² > a² + b²), the triangle is obtuse. The altitude drawn to the shorter sides will fall outside the triangle.

Base and Altitude Relationship

A triangle has three altitudes. The shortest altitude always corresponds to the longest side, and the longest altitude corresponds to the shortest side, since Area = (1/2) × base × height is constant.

questions.question: Solve: ((100.5)² - (79.2)²)/(100.5 + 79.2)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (a² − b²) ÷ (a + b) = a − b

Here a = 100.5 and b = 79.2

So expression simplifies directly to 100.5 − 79.2

= 21.3

**∴ Answer = 21.3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

((100.5)² − (79.2)²) ÷ (100.5 + 79.2)

**Formula used:**

(a² − b²) = (a − b)(a + b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ ((100.5 − 79.2)(100.5 + 79.2)) ÷ (100.5 + 79.2)

⇒ Cancel (100.5 + 79.2)

⇒ = 100.5 − 79.2

⇒ = 21.3

**∴ The correct answer is 21.3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference of Squares Identity

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

Cancellation Rule

Common factors in numerator and denominator can be cancelled.

Simplification Trick

Recognizing identities avoids lengthy calculations.

Algebraic Identities Use

Common identities help reduce expressions quickly and accurately.
